questions.question: Discuss techniques to gather customer insights. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• Discuss techniques to gather customer insights.
  • Definition (1 mark) Customer insights are the understanding of customer needs, behaviours,
  • and problems.
  • Techniques (Any 4 points – 1 mark each)
  • Interviews
  • Direct interaction with customers to understand feelings and needs.
  • Observation
  • Watching users while using a product or service.
  • Surveys and Questionnaires
  • Collecting opinions from many users quickly.
  • Focus Groups
  • Group discussion to gather different viewpoints.
  • Customer Journey Mapping
  • Studying customer experience step by step.
  • Feedback Analysis
  • Examining reviews and complaints.

questions.question: Define the term 'Wicked Problem' in the context of social and cultural issues. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:

  • Definition (2 marks) A wicked problem is a complex social or cultural problem with no single
  • correct solution.
  • Characteristics (Any 3 points – 1 mark each)
  • Difficult to define
  • Multiple causes
  • No permanent solution
  • Different opinions from stakeholders
  • Example : (1 mark)(Traffic congestion or climate change.)

questions.question: Differentiate between Low-Fidelity and High-Fidelity Prototypes. / [CO3] [5x7 = 35]
questions.solution_html:
• Differentiate between Low-Fidelity and High-Fidelity Prototypes.
  • Low-Fidelity Prototype:
  • • Simple and rough • Cheap and fast • Used in early stages
  • High-Fidelity Prototype:
  • • Detailed and realistic • Costly and time-consuming • Used in final stages
  • Examples:
  • • Low-fidelity: Paper sketch
  • • High-fidelity: Interactive app demo
